$comment: engine.worklife (MOD-080) module-owned data surface: the three time patterns (core-hours / shift / any-time), and the placeholder working-week policy values. Loaded via internal/engine/worklife's LoadWorklife (foundation/data's generic Load[T]). §42: the 168-hour weekly discretionary-hours budget couples work hours to wellbeing; §52: the working-week policy lever (default ~40h vs 996 9-to-9/6-day); §18: wellbeing, where the 996 cost lands. Aaron 2026-08-16 design (BOW FEAT-137). GR#15 balance-number regime: every hour/wage/wellbeing figure below is a PLACEHOLDER pending Aaron's balance pass (ASM-953) — direction only (996 hours > default; 996 wage > default; 996 wellbeing < default). The workingWeekPolicies block documents the placeholder values MOD-064 will author in policies.json; at runtime engine.worklife reads the ACTIVE effect through its PoliciesAPI seam, never this table.

meta.design: Aaron 2026-08-16 design: time patterns (9-5 core-hours/teacher model, 24x7 shift/nurse model, any-time), schedule-driven commute, a 40h-vs-996 working-week policy, and the overwork trade.
meta.balance: PLACEHOLDERS pending Aaron's balance pass (ASM-953). Default working week ~40h (hoursPerDay × daysPerWeek = 8 × 5, per pattern). 996 = 9-to-9 across 6 days = 72h/week. Wage multiplier and wellbeing weight are directional placeholders.

units.coverageSpanHours: hours/day the role must be staffed
units.wageCoefficient: dimensionless multiplier on the base wage
units.wellbeingWeight: dimensionless overwork cost subtracted from the §42 discretionary-hours balance

patterns.label: Core hours (9-to-5 teacher model)
patterns.disclosure: Not a balance placeholder: this is the documented 9-5 core-hours pattern from the Aaron 2026-08-16 design. The 8h/day × 5 days/week = 40h default-week total IS the ~40h default the balance regime names, pending Aaron's balance pass.

patterns.label: Shift (24x7 nurse model)
patterns.disclosure: Not a balance placeholder: this is the documented 24x7 shift pattern from the Aaron 2026-08-16 design (three 8h rotations tiling the day). Rotation length/count are directional placeholders (ASM-954) pending the master-plan sync.
patterns.specRef: Aaron 2026-08-16 design: 24x7 shift (nurse model), three 8h rotations

patterns.label: Any-time (flexible)
patterns.disclosure: Not a balance placeholder: this is the documented any-time pattern from the Aaron 2026-08-16 design. The 8h/day × 5 days/week = 40h default-week total IS the ~40h default the balance regime names. Flexible placement (where in the day the 8h sits) is deterministic per worker, never a balance number.
patterns.specRef: Aaron 2026-08-16 design: any-time flexible placement within weekly hours

workingWeekPolicies.label: 996 (9-to-9, 6 days)
workingWeekPolicies.wageCoefficientUnit: dimensionless multiplier on the base wage
workingWeekPolicies.wellbeingWeightUnit: dimensionless overwork cost subtracted from the §42 discretionary-hours balance
workingWeekPolicies.disclosure: PLACEHOLDER pending Aaron's balance pass (ASM-953): the 72h/week (9-to-9 across 6 days), the 1.8 wage multiplier, and the 0.25 wellbeing weight are directional figures only. MOD-064 will author the real working-week policy in policies.json; these values are what engine.worklife's tests consume until then.
